choice.div: Layering controls so one failure does not compromise everything.
Keeping all systems on one flat network.

div.p: Every control can fail. Layering means an attacker must beat several before reaching the asset.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: The single highest-value activity for reducing endpoint risk is:

div.p: Unpatched vulnerabilities are the most exploited entry point. Patch management beats almost every other control for effort returned.

choiceresponse.p: Which are network-segmentation benefits? Select all that apply.

choice.div: Limiting lateral movement during an incident
Separating guests and IoT from servers

div.p: Segmentation constrains an attacker's reach and isolates untrusted devices. It does not replace authentication.
